name: contact-05
description: A list of studio offices with time zones, phone numbers and copyable emails.

files.content:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Check, Copy, Mail, Phone } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const offices = [ { city: "London", timezone: "GMT", email: "london@fieldwork.co", phone: "+44 20 7946 0958", address: ["48 Shoreditch High St", "London E1 6PG"], }, { city: "New York", timezone: "EST", email: "nyc@fieldwork.co", phone: "+1 212 555 0187", address: ["101 Greene St, Floor 4", "New York, NY 10012"], }, { city: "Singapore", timezone: "SGT", email: "sg@fieldwork.co", phone: "+65 6555 0143", address: ["8 Club St, #03-01", "Singapore 069472"], }, ] export default function Contact05() { const [copied, setCopied] = useState(null) function copy(value: string) { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(value) setCopied(value) setTimeout(() => setCopied(null), 1600) } return (

Three studios,
one team.

Reach the office closest to you. Every studio handles new business, press and careers.

{offices.map((office) => (

{office.city}

{office.timezone}
{office.address.map((line) => ( {line} ))}
))}
) }
